meta.revision: 2 (2026-10-05 review: map narrative a P1, b correction, c R1, d training range; native-grid cell mesh; slide size 12.0 x <=5.2 in; XL two-row comparison; XK categorical support axis)
meta.scope: ALT 1 km maps (Alaska, Lena Delta), XK support-scale error, XL product comparison and display-resolution figures. Paper v3 comparison folder and report deck assets
meta.inputs_not_recomputed: figures reuse the saved prediction and summary tables; no prediction was rerun for revision 2

paper.labels: panel letters only on map figures; short noun labels where a figure is a matrix (XL product names, XK region names)
export: pdf (fonttype 42, text vector, only cell meshes and hatch layers rasterised at 600 dpi)
svg only for XK (map SVGs dropped, 34-40 MB each)

slide.font: Pretendard Medium; ticks and titles 16 pt, colour-bar labels 16 pt (14 pt for vertical XL bars), grey annotations 12-14 pt
slide.rules: all legends and labels inside the canvas, colour bars directly under or beside their panels, coordinates once per row

colormaps.alt: cmcrameri oslo_r truncated 0.12-0.90, 250 levels; range = 1st-99th percentile of the panels sharing it, rounded outward to 5 cm (XL top row: pooled 2nd-98th percentile)
colormaps.difference: cmcrameri broc, TwoSlopeNorm(vcenter=0), symmetric; vmax = 99th percentile of |values| rounded up to 5 cm (XL product differences: pooled 98th percentile)
colormaps.levels_note: 250-level LUT keeps each PDF raster at <=256 colours (indexed image)

common.cells: native 0.009 deg x 0.009/cos(phi) deg rectangles drawn as one QuadMesh per panel (rows stacked, zero-height gap rows transparent); no resampling

masks.extrapolation: hatching by number of covariates outside the 0.5-99.5 percentile range of the training rows: '//' 1, '////' 2, 'xxx' 3 or more (#9a9a9a, 1.0 pt), key drawn as a hatched colour bar

common.basemap: Natural Earth 10 m land #f4f4f4 and coastline #bdbdbd 1.0 pt, clipped to the region and simplified (Alaska 0.01 deg, Lena 0.002 deg); graticule #e0e0e0 1.0 pt
common.scale_bar: placed in a map corner with no coloured cells and no coastline points (automatic check); otherwise below a panel frame that has no coordinate labels
common.location_inset: pan-Arctic inset in an empty map corner, otherwise outside the maps (paper: above the shared ALT colour bar); omitted on slides when no corner is empty
common.label_cells: black dots in the training-range panel only

Alaska_ALT_map_v3.message: a + b = c: the residual ML correction is a few cm and varies at the ERA5-Land grid scale; 73 % of the mapped area lies outside the training covariate range

panels.c: residual ML ALT (R1, lambda 0.5), shared scale with a (35-75 cm)
panels.d: training range (covariates outside range, label cells)

Alaska_ALT_map_v3.layout_paper: 2 x 2, 170 x 130.5 mm; vertical colour bar for a and c between the columns, vertical bar for b and hatched key for d on the right
Alaska_ALT_map_v3.layout_slide: 1 x 4, 12.0 x 4.1 in, colour bars under panels, scale bar under b, legend entries under d
Alaska_ALT_map_v3.interval: constant +/-20.2 cm stated in the legend with its limitation, not mapped

Lena_ALT_map_v3.message: same structure as Alaska; climate-row banding visible in a; 84 % of the mapped area outside the training range
Lena_ALT_map_v3.projection: polar stereographic, central meridian 126.7 deg E, true scale 70 deg N

panels.c: residual ML ALT (h49 panel c), shared scale with a (35-50 cm)
panels.d: training range (training rows = source cells and Lena labels)

Lena_ALT_map_v3.dropped: source Stefan interval panel (h49 panels a, d); the final constant +/-25.4 cm interval is stated in the legend

XL_product_differences.message: product levels on one scale (top) and product minus residual ML on one diverging scale (bottom); Stefan minus residual ML on its own +/-10 cm scale
XL_product_differences.top_row: residual ML, CCI v5, Wei 2026, Aalto 2018, Yi-Kimball (Alaska); grey text under each map: area mean and Pearson r against the residual ML map (from xl_summary_v1.csv; numbers in the figure by explicit review request)
XL_product_differences.bottom_row: Stefan - residual ML, product - residual ML; titles use U+2212
XL_product_differences.layout_paper: 2 rows, horizontal colour bars (top row shared, bottom row: Stefan own + products shared), scale bar below the last panel
XL_product_differences.layout_slide: 2 rows, vertical colour bars, two-line bottom titles, 12.0 x 4.8 in (Alaska) and 12.0 x 5.2 in (Lena)

XL_display_resolution.message: the 1 km map is nearly constant within ERA5-Land 0.1 deg cells (Alaska) and carries weak within-cell detail (Lena)
XL_display_resolution.panels: a Alaska 1 km, b Alaska 0.1 deg mean (50 x 50 km around the label-richest block, ERA5 cell boundaries in white), c Lena 1 km, d Lena 0.1 deg mean; equal square panels; native-cell mesh
XL_display_resolution.colour: one bar per region, 1st-99th percentile of both panels in 2 cm steps (Alaska 42-54, Lena 38-48 cm)

XK_support_scale.message: RMSE versus aggregation size; Stefan minus residual ML difference by size (descriptive, no verdict words)
XK_support_scale.layout: 2 rows x 3 regions; x = categorical, evenly spaced (1 km, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25 deg) with grey grid-cell counts under the ticks
XK_support_scale.top: cell-weighted RMSE, log axis 8-100 cm shared; CI bands (alpha 0.15) for recalibrated Stefan and residual ML only; cell sets with_yk (Alaska), common (Lena, Canada)
XK_support_scale.bottom: RMSE(Stefan) - RMSE(residual ML) with 95 % block bootstrap CIs, cell-weighted (filled, 2.0 pt) and block-equal (open, 1.0 pt), zero line; cell set models; shared y -5 to 6 cm
